en: A vintage black‑and‑white postcard view of a landscaped city park with lawns, curving paths, and many trees. In the center stands an ornate monument or statue on a multi‑tiered pedestal. In the distance, partly obscured by trees, is a church tower with a clock and spire. At the top of the card, printed in red Gothic-style script, is a caption identifying the location as Frankenberg in Saxony and the specific park as Friedenspark.
